split: test (7 held-out videos, never seen in training)
model: YOLOv8n-cls, ImageNet-pretrained, fine-tuned on EV2 (Zenodo 13771384, CC-BY 4.0)
selected_epoch: best validation top-1 (epoch 9: 0.9348 on 5 validation videos)
task: is a Varroa mite visible on this bee in this frame
note: 310 of the 323 'no visible mite' test frames come from infested bees whose mite is out of view; the one fully Varroa-free test bee (13 frames) was classified correctly in all frames.
